name: "you picked your poison"
source:
You find yourself in the hands of a jaded leafling, poisoned close to your death.

Can you convince her to let you live?

[From [url=https://cedesdc.itch.io/you-picked-your-poison]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己落入了一只疲惫不堪的小叶之手，中毒濒临死亡。

你能说服她让你活下去吗？

[来自[url=https://cedesdc.itch.io/you-picked-your-poison]itch.io[/url]]
